interface.route: mori simulate on the holdout draft call (sherlock-helper-microstep/1, moriarty-sherlock-draft/1, --entry); the residual flags add a top-level `residual` and must not change execution.summary
interface.reference: ResidualStepIR specializes the K-A reference step (sherlock-k-a/1, the relation published by --reference-slices); ir.reference_definition_id = 'sherlock-k-a/1'

config.residual_size_limit: decimal string > 0 (default chosen by the tool when the flag is absent)

ir.ir_id: sha256 hex of canonical JSON (sort_keys, separators , and :, UTF-8) of ir without ir_id
ir.program_image_id: 64-hex for per-program, null for universal and family
ir.blocks: [{block_id, kind: static-dispatch|dynamic-branch|runtime-call|return|step|generic-dispatch, rules:[K-A rule_start_line], folded:[subset of static_bindings.kinds], successors:[block_id], dynamic-branch: selector (a dynamic input) and >=2 successors, runtime-call: unrolled=false, frame_check='dynamic'}]; len(blocks) <= residual_size_limit
ir.dynamic_inputs: superset of control, data, environment, frames, depth, fuel, work, helper-cursor, capacity-checks, outcome
ir.static_bindings: {kinds: subset of code, declarations, layout, family, source-occurrence-ids, operand-slices; universal only layout; family only layout+family (and family: F); per-program includes code and program_image_id}
ir.rule_boundary_map: [{rule_start_line, block_id, charge}] covering every K-A rule the program exercises, with its reference charge

worklist.fallback_used: bool, true iff generic_fallbacks non-empty (then a generic-dispatch block exists)

residual.execution: the residual realization EXECUTED on this run (same program, fuel, stack) as a moriarty-sherlock-reference-slices/1 document with group_budget 1; its StepRecord stream must equal --reference-slices 1, AND every record carries block_id = the residual block that produced it: that block's rules contain the record's rule_start_line (or it is generic-dispatch), and each next record's block is the same block, one of its successors, or follows a generic-dispatch block

interface.invariants: ir_id independent of fuel and stack; universal and family ir_id identical across programs; per-program block structure independent of recursion depth; --residual-size-limit 0 and unknown families refused (nonzero exit, no completed execution)
interface.evaluator_note: Evaluator-authored (sherlock-eval 2026-10-25) from the spec, interfaces.md and demonstrators.md; implementer proposals reviewed. The holdout reads the flags below; a spelling change is a CONTRACT CHANGE posted to sherlock-eval. sherlock-s5's models/sherlock/qa/residualize.py (a five-rule hand table that never sees the program) would be judged a gap report: the residual must realize the real reference relation. CONTRACT CHANGE 2026-10-26 (evaluator, after quint-3's 'post-hoc replay' finding on s5 WIP): records carry block_id and must follow the IR's control edges.
